lines.en: Oh, it was good. Actually, the baby started kicking.
Yeah, I know. Oh, it was amazing.
The only sad thing is I wasn't around when it happened for the first time.
Yeah, I know. And I was missing out on all this other stuff, too.
So, Joey suggested Rachel move in with me.
Joey cracks me up. It's like,
yeah, why don't you have your ex-wife move in with you?
That wouldn't be awkward at all.
I go away for a few days, I come back,
and my boyfriend is living with some woman he got pregnant.
Hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo.
